In development

Programs in development.

Alongside our brokerage, we are developing specialty insurance programs and pursuing delegated underwriting authority in select niches. These are in development, and separate from our current brokerage operations.

Scroll to explore

In development

Equine MGA

Mortality, major medical, and specified perils for the US equine market, from thoroughbreds to working farm stock.

Early stage

Government & Sovereign Programs

Nation-scale risk and reconstruction programs for governments and public entities. A sovereign program is in active development, with a letter of intent in motion.

In development

Commercial Auto & Occupational Accident

Specialty transportation with telematics-driven underwriting, using fleet data at submission, not after the loss.

In development

Warranty & MBI

Construction equipment, HVAC, and industrial equipment protection, a natural adjacency to our inland marine book.

In design

TeleMetra Tradesmen

Purpose-built coverage for the emerging skilled-trades workforce, scalable by trade class, state, and channel.

Exploratory

Rent-A-Car Program

Fleet liability and rental operator coverage for the independent and franchise operators the majors overlook.

Exploratory

Parametric

Index-based and event-triggered products for climate, catastrophe, and business-interruption exposures.

In development

Energy MGA

A dedicated energy program in development, from construction and contractors through power and renewables.

In development

Contingency

Event cancellation, prize indemnity, and specialty contingency risk, in development.

Always growing

And more, always

New programs are always in the works. Tell us the class you want written, and we will go build it.
